profiles.name: drum-machines
profiles.text:
# name: drum machine
# publish: yes
# Drums first: the X0X 909 and 808 kits, the drum synth with KAWA and PLAITS, the sampled kits and drum EDIT; SAMPLE and
# GRAIN for the tracks. USB audio + MIDI, Bluetooth MIDI (devices at FULL) and Bluetooth audio, the web editor (backup,
# librarian, the screen mirror), the help line, PATTERNS, live save. Off: every other synth engine (ANALOG 2, FM6, DIGITAL

flavours.title: Synths, USB audio, Bluetooth audio and MIDI
